training_ground: Puy des Folles official 1 m rendered bathymetry plus FKt230303 ground truth

blindness_boundary.reason: The official NOAA rendered 1 m map and published ROV/vent ground-truth information were reviewed before this calibration receipt was frozen. This run must not be reported as a pristine blind holdout.
blindness_boundary.allowed_claim: Calibration of morphology confounders and evidence ceilings only.

public_inputs.description: Official rendered overview based on 1 m AUV bathymetry over the summit of Puy des Folles.
Processed gridded AUV bathymetry: 1 m grids across Puy des Folles, EMARK/Falkor EMARK and Hydra, plus 0.5 m grids over three Puy chimney fields.
ESRI ASCII representation of the processed gridded bathymetry.

reported_features: approximately 1 km wide graben/fault-block complex on western summit
parallel and oblique normal faults on eastern summit
hundreds of circular and elliptical pits
multiple chimney clusters, with structures up to roughly 24 m
active high-temperature black smokers confirmed by ROV

visual_calibration_observations.lesson: Long, regular, repeated linear structure can be entirely geological; linearity is not engineering evidence.
Parallel boundaries and rectilinear-looking blocks can arise naturally from extensional tectonics.
Repeated round depressions are a strong false-positive family for crater/shaft/constructed-hole interpretations.
Abrupt edges and faceted relief can be ordinary mass wasting and fault morphology.
Small pinnacles can nominate targets but cannot establish active hydrothermal venting without independent process evidence.

ROV_ground_truth_anchors.role: historical vent-field reference only, not an exact active-smoker label

ROV_ground_truth_anchors.reported_context: NW chimney group approximately 140 x 100 m; about 10 spires roughly 5-12 m high were mapped as targets; ROV used the AUV map for ground truth.
Dive began at a large active chimney and continued through additional mapped waypoints searching for active structures.
A chimney identified from preliminary AUV data; plume results plus bathymetry strongly indicated an active hydrothermal target before ROV verification.
Return sampling dive to the active vent found during the preceding Hydra exploration dive.

transfer_to_tesla_sweep.terrain_lesson: fault lineaments, pits and pinnacles can look deliberate
transfer_to_tesla_sweep.signal_lesson: lines, combs, pulse trains and number-like cadences can look deliberate

transfer_to_tesla_sweep.terrain_lesson: plume plus map convergence raises confidence
transfer_to_tesla_sweep.signal_lesson: independent antennas/instruments plus physically consistent timing, Doppler or dispersion raise confidence

transfer_to_tesla_sweep.terrain_lesson: ROV localized ground truth resolves the source
transfer_to_tesla_sweep.signal_lesson: independent source-localizing replication is the closest signal analogue
